title: Who Is Safeguarding Me?
quote_highlights: I have no emergency contact. No assigned officer. No advocate. No backup plan. So again, who is safeguarding me?
The ICO gave me an answer. The IOPC gave me a referral slip back to my abuser.
If I die, this time you will know exactly who did nothing.
summary: A forensic escalation of the central safeguarding contradiction: multiple agencies have either refused, redirected, or erased their duty of care. This VEX entry asks the question that echoes through the entire complaint: If every institution deflects, then who is safeguarding Ben Carter?
